issuing_body: National Information Society Agency (NIA), Republic of Korea
implementation_notes: This is a non-binding guideline for public sector adoption of hyperscale AI (초거대 AI / LLM). It provides procedural guidance on data security classification, cloud service configuration, learning methods, service introduction approaches, SLO, and maintenance. It references CSAP certification requirements under the Cloud Computing Act. No explicit prohibited practices or penalties are stated. Publication date is estimated as March 2024 based on internal references to market data as of March 2024.
